message: You know you’re in trouble when you find yourself searching for hot cocoa in the middle of a snowstorm, only to realize you’ve run out. 🤦‍♀️ Winter weather can be a bit unpredictable, but being prepared doesn’t have to be a comedy of errors. I’ve learned that a little planning goes a long way—who knew that some extra blankets and snacks could bring such peace of mind? What’s your go-to winter comfort?
